google_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8 (Designed for Families). No login, no accounts, no chat. Every purchase, Restore purchases and the privacy-policy link sit behind a parental gate: tap the lock (top corner of the home screen) and PRESS AND HOLD the correct answer to the multiplication shown (e.g. 7 x 8 = 56) for about 1.5 seconds. Free content: tap-to-count 1 to 20, tracing digits 0 to 9, the Count by 2s song and the How many? game. full_pack unlocks counting to 100 (hundred chart), the Count by 5s and 10s songs and the Make the number and What comes next games, and removes ads; remove_ads removes the banner only. Ads: AdMob banner only, child-directed (TFCD, TFUA, max rating G), never on play screens; no interstitial or rewarded ads, no notifications, no Play Games, no Firebase.
apple_review_notes: Kids app for ages 3-8. No login. Purchases and links are behind a parental gate: tap the lock on the home screen and press and hold the correct answer to the multiplication shown. Free: counting 1 to 20, tracing, the 2s song and one game; the one-time All counting fun purchase unlocks the rest.
